description: Design-token system + global UI shell (Phase 1). Foundation that every later FEAT depends on: tokens.css, app/sidebar/topbar backgrounds, logo + nav icons, global button art, active-nav glow, and the HealthStatusPill component.
steps: Create src/assets/styles/tokens.css with the :root custom properties from plan.md (colours, borders, glows, --asset-* path strings). Import it in src/main.ts immediately after `import './assets/main.css'`.

Set body background to url('/assets/ui/app-background.png') center/cover no-repeat fixed (in main.css base layer). Apply /assets/ui/side-nav-background.png (background-size cover) to the <aside> in src/shared/components/AppSidebar.vue and /assets/ui/topbar-background.png to the <header> top bar in src/shared/components/AppLayout.vue, preserving existing text contrast and layout classes.
In AppSidebar.vue add the active-nav glow: when isActive(item.to), apply background rgba(124,58,237,0.15); border-left:3px solid var(--color-purple); box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px rgba(124,58,237,0.1).

In AppSidebar.vue replace the logo SVG with sized 40x40 object-fit:contain, with the 'Aircane Tabletop' text label to its right (respect the collapsed state). Replace the 8 nav SVGs that have a matching PNG (icon-library/campaign/character/rules/ai/adventure/dice/about) with per the map in plan.md; KEEP the Dashboard SVG (no icon-dashboard.png exists).

In src/assets/main.css @layer components, extend .btn-primary / .btn-secondary with background-image url('/assets/ui/primary-button-glow.png') / secondary-button-glow.png and background-size:100% 100% (no added border on the art); keep text centered and existing padding/focus states.

Create src/shared/components/HealthStatusPill.vue with props { status: 'healthy' | 'error'; label: string } rendering a pill with a glowing dot (green via --glow-green for healthy, red via --glow-red for error) using tokens. Optionally refactor HealthStatus.vue to render it (map 'unreachable'->'error', 'unknown'->muted) WITHOUT changing health-polling behavior.
Add src/shared/components/__tests__/HealthStatusPill.test.ts: mount with status 'healthy' and 'error', assert the label text renders and the correct status class is applied.
acceptance_criteria: src/assets/styles/tokens.css exists and is imported in main.ts; `npm run build` succeeds.
Sidebar shows app-logo-mark.png + 'Aircane Tabletop' and PNG icons on the 8 mapped nav items; Dashboard keeps its SVG.
body, sidebar, and top bar render their background images via absolute /assets/... paths.
HealthStatusPill.vue renders healthy/error states and its test passes.
`npm test` reports all tests passing including the new HealthStatusPill test.
verification: cd src/frontend/aircane-web && npm run build  (succeeds, 0 type errors)
cd src/frontend/aircane-web && npm test  (all tests pass, including HealthStatusPill.test.ts)
findings:
Done. Build + tests green: 27 files / 251 tests pass (baseline 249 + 2 new HealthStatusPill tests). Files changed: - src/assets/styles/tokens.css (new): :root tokens from plan.md. Imported in src/main.ts right after './assets/main.css'. Later phases should consume these vars (e.g. var(--color-purple), var(--glow-purple), var(--border-radius-pill)). The --asset-* vars are quoted path strings for reference only; actual asset URLs use literal absolute '/assets//' paths. - src/assets/main.css: body now has `background: url('/assets/ui/app-background.png') center/cover no-repeat fixed` in @layer base (kept the Tailwind bg-surface-950 as fallback). .btn-primary / .btn-secondary extended with background-image (primary-button-glow.png / secondary-button-glow.png) + background-size:100% 100% + background-repeat:no-repeat; added justify-center; REMOVED the CSS border from .btn-secondary since the art bakes its own border (per global rule). Added reusable `.section-divider` helper class (width:100%; max-width:600px; mx-auto block) for later phases' dividers. - src/shared/components/AppLayout.vue:
top bar got inline style background-image topbar-background.png, background-size:cover, position center. Kept existing border/bg/backdrop classes for contrast. - src/shared/components/AppSidebar.vue:
got side-nav-background.png (cover, center). Logo SVG replaced with and label text changed from 'Aircane' to 'Aircane Tabletop' (respects collapsed). navItems now carry optional iconSrc; the 8 mapped items render and Dashboard keeps its inline SVG (no icon-dashboard.png). NOTE filename quirk: campaigns->icon-campaign.png and characters->icon-character.png (singular). Removed the 8 now-unreachable nav SVGs. Active-nav glow: RouterLink carries class 'nav-item' + 'active' when isActive; scoped
